description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Voucher' class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Sale namespace. The class provides methods for managing vouchers, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving voucher data from the database.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents the model for handling voucher-related database operations within the admin sale context.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher record into the database with provided data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editVoucher
methods.description: Updates an existing voucher record identified by voucher_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteVoucher
methods.description: Deletes a voucher record by voucher_id and clears associated histories.

methods.name: getVoucher
methods.description: Retrieves a specific voucher's details using its voucher_id.

methods.name: getVoucherByCode
methods.description: Fetches a voucher's details using its unique code.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of vouchers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalVouchers
methods.description: Returns the total count of vouchers in the database.

methods.name: getTotalVouchersByVoucherThemeId
methods.description: Returns the count of vouchers associated with a specific voucher theme ID.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a specific voucher.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes history records linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of voucher histories with pagination for a specific voucher.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a specific voucher.
